agentBatches.summary: Read repo examples, created dedicated worktree/branch, established official trail overview, section order, official distances/times/difficulty from Borås Stad, Naturkartan GPX availability for all 10 stages, OSM relation inventory, key caveats and initial geometry metrics.

Six parallel research/report agents completed for section 1 Hindås station to Hestrafors IF. Main thread synthesized official sources, GPX/OSM geometry, facilities, commute/access, field reports and rules/safety into the section research JSON.

knownGaps: Only section 1 has a synthesized section JSON packet; sections 2 through 10 still need six-agent section research and synthesis.

Section 1 Klippan naturreservat overlap and winter ski-track access near Hindås/Hindåsgården remain unresolved.
